executive_summary: On July 1, 2026, OFAC added 18 entities and individuals to the SDN list, primarily targeting those involved in illicit drug trafficking and Specially Designated Global Terrorists (SDGT). Four entities were removed from the list, all of which were previously designated under the Russia-related EO14024 program. No updates were made to existing listings.
